data.title: Spacewalk Preps, Robotics Jobs, and Science Duties Fill Tuesday Schedule - NASA
data.description: Spacewalking tools and a pair of robotics jobs topped Tuesday’s schedule aboard the International Space Station. The Expedition 75 crew members also kept up their scientific duties configuring botany research hardware and setting up advanced Earth observation gear.
data.keywords: Expedition 75, International Space Station (ISS), ISS Research
